Remark
[Remark 2.11] 1. ch9:2.11It is possible to establish formulas for the first and second variations of the arc length function $L(s)$. The expressions are entirely analogous to those for the energy and, since they will not be used here, are not treated (see [dC 2] paragraph 5.4).
